title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
江南市的六月，空气像一块拧不干的湿抹布，紧紧贴在皮肤上。江南三中高三（7）班的早自习铃，就在这样黏腻的晨光里，撕拉着划破了教室的闷热。林宇的鼻尖几乎要碰到摊开的《五年高考三年模拟》，但他视线聚焦的，却是夹在习题册里的半张a4纸。纸上用铅笔勾勒着复杂的洛伦兹变换公式，旁边歪歪扭扭写着批注：“若引入额外维度参数，时间项或可出现负解——致王浩教授”。这是他昨晚偷摸给京都大学物理系教授写的邮件草稿，手指无意识地在桌下摩挲着廉价钢笔的笔帽，留下一圈浅浅的汗渍。“哟，林大状元又在研究什么宇宙奥秘呢？”前排传来刻意压低却足够清晰的嗤笑。赵天雷转过身，校服外套松垮地搭在肩上，露出里面印着限量版潮牌的t恤。他手肘往林宇桌上一撑，袖口滑落，露出一截银光闪闪的腕表——那是最新款的军用通讯表，表带内侧刻着不易察觉的鹰徽标志。林宇没抬头，只是往旁边挪了挪卷子：“赵少有事？”“没事就不能跟你聊聊？”赵天雷咧嘴一笑，露出镶了金边的后槽牙，突然手腕一斜，“啪嗒”一声，林宇放在桌角的搪瓷水杯被撞翻，褐色的豆浆泼了一桌子，正好浸湿了他夹在书里的那半张a4纸。“抱歉啊，手滑。”赵天雷语气里毫无歉意，反而带着一丝隐秘的快意。他看着林宇猛地站起身，看着那摊豆浆迅速晕开，将洛伦兹公式泡得模糊，眼底掠过一丝不易察觉的兴奋。林宇攥紧了拳头，指甲几乎嵌进掌心。他知道赵天雷为什么针对他。从高一开始，这个仗着父亲是军区后勤部长、母亲是上市公司老总的纨绔子弟，就没给过他好脸色。起初他以为是成绩排名的竞争，但当赵天雷开始在苏清影面前刻意刁难他时，林宇才明白那点微妙的嫉妒。苏清影，高三（7）班的班长，也是公认的校花。她抱着一摞作业本从教室后门进来，白色的连衣裙裙摆扫过过道，带起一阵若有似无的栀子花香。看到林宇桌前的狼藉，她愣了一下，随即快步走过来，从包里拿出纸巾：“怎么回事？”“没事，”林宇接过纸巾，尽量压下火气，“赵少不小心碰倒了。”赵天雷靠在椅背上，手指敲着林宇的练习册，眼神在苏清影和林宇之间来回逡巡，带着一种捕猎者的审视：“林宇，跟清影说话呢？正好，我这儿有道‘物理题’，你不是号称解题王吗？敢不敢试试？”他从抽屉里掏出一个牛皮纸信封，晃了晃：“答出来，我下周升旗礼上，当着全校面喊你三声‘林宇爸爸’。答不出来……”他故意拖长了音调，目光落在苏清影身上，“那就请清影去新开的星际影城看首映，怎么样？”林宇皱眉。赵天雷的“题”从来没安好心。上周他就拿了道所谓的“奥赛题”，结果是道无解的悖论，纯粹想让他在苏清影面前出丑。苏清影把最后一本作业本放在林宇桌上，轻声说：“快早自习了，别闹了。”她的声音像清晨的露珠，让林宇心头的火气消了不少。“别啊清影，”赵天雷打开信封，抽出一张a4纸，“就当帮林宇放松一下，高考压力大嘛。”他把纸拍在林宇面前，“你看这题，难不难？”林宇下意识地低头看去。纸上印着一组复杂的流体力学公式，配图却是一个扭曲的机翼截面图，翼尖处有个奇怪的锯齿状结构。公式里夹杂着几个他从未见过的符号，像是某种特殊的变量标识。“这是……”林宇刚想仔细看看，赵天雷突然用笔尖戳向纸张，“看清楚了？矢量流体场方程，加上这个翼型设计，够你琢磨一阵了吧？”就在这时，教室后墙的监控摄像头轻微转动了一下，红色的工作指示灯闪了闪。赵天雷袖口的通讯表突然震动了一下，屏幕上快速闪过一行加密信息：“目标已送达教务处，按计划执行。”他不动声色地按灭屏幕，嘴角勾起一抹冷笑。林宇没注意到这些细节。他的注意力被纸上的一个标注吸引了——在机翼截面图的角落，用极淡的铅笔写着“β-7合金应力测试”。这几个字让他心头一凛，β-7合金是军方高度保密的新型材料，他只在父亲留下的旧资料里见过一次模糊的提及。“怎么？不敢答？”赵天雷见他迟疑，立刻乘胜追击，“还是说，连看都看不懂？”林宇深吸一口气，正要开口，突然感觉脚下碰到了什么东西。他弯腰去捡刚才被豆浆浸湿的练习册，眼角余光瞥见赵天雷的运动鞋鞋底。那是一双限量版的aj，鞋跟处沾着一小块不起眼的碎纸。碎纸边缘有些焦黑，像是被火燎过，上面用四号宋体印着几个字：“绝密·六代机……”后面的字被鞋底的纹路磨掉了，但“绝密”两个红色印章和“六代机”三个字，像一道闪电劈中了林宇的大脑。六代机？！龙国正在研发的第六代隐形战机，属于最高级别的国家机密，连网络上都只有零星的猜测，赵天雷的鞋底怎么会有这种碎纸？林宇猛地抬头，正好对上赵天雷探究的目光。后者似乎察觉到了什么，下意识地把脚往后缩了缩，脸上的笑容也淡了几分：“看什么看？答不出来就直说，别磨磨蹭蹭的。”

就在这时，教室前门传来脚步声。监考老师老王拿着保温杯走进来，他昨晚似乎没睡好，眼睛里布满血丝，打了个大大的哈欠。阳光透过窗户，照在他胸前的领带夹上——那是个造型普通的金属夹，此刻却将光线反射到赵天雷放在桌上的a4纸上。奇妙的事情发生了。领带夹反射的光斑，恰好落在机翼截面图的进气道位置，与纸上的线条组合在一起，竟然形成了一个完整的三维引擎剖面图！虽然只是惊鸿一瞥，但林宇清楚地看到了图中复杂的内循环结构，那绝不是普通飞机引擎该有的设计。“叮铃铃——”早自习结束的铃声突兀地响起，打断了林宇的思绪。赵天雷迅速抽回那张a4纸，塞进信封：“怎么样，林宇？想好了吗？敢不敢赌？”林宇看着他，又下意识地瞟了一眼他的鞋底——那块碎纸已经被赵天雷悄悄蹭掉了。但刚才看到的“绝密·六代机”和领带夹反射的引擎图，像两颗投入湖面的石子，在他心里激起了层层涟漪。他想起父亲临终前留下的那个铁盒，里面除了几张泛黄的旧照片，还有一本封面磨损的《航空动力基础》，扉页上用钢笔写着：“技术无国界，但科学家有祖国。”父亲曾是航空工业的工程师，后来因故离职，郁郁而终。难道赵天雷的家族，和父亲的过去有什么联系？“赌就赌。”林宇突然开口，声音不大，却异常坚定。他不知道赵天雷的目的是什么，也不知道这张奇怪的a4纸背后隐藏着什么，但他能感觉到，有什么东西正在悄然改变。赵天雷愣了一下，似乎没想到林宇会答应。他随即露出笑容：“好！够种！那就等着瞧吧。”说完，他转身坐回座位，从口袋里摸出手机，快速编辑了一条信息：“饵已上钩，按计划替换试卷。”窗外，一架涂装着民用标识的直升机悄然掠过教学楼顶，螺旋桨的轰鸣声被教室的隔音玻璃过滤成低沉的嗡嗡声。没有人注意到，直升机腹部的吊舱里，正缓缓降下一个被铅封的金属箱，目标直指学校教务处的保密室。林宇看着赵天雷的背影，又低头看了看桌上被豆浆浸湿的痕迹。那些晕开的墨迹，不知为何，竟然组成了一个极其微小的、类似能量循环的漩涡图案。他下意识地用手指描摹着那个图案，突然感觉指尖传来一阵微弱的电流感，像是有什么东西，正在黑暗中悄然苏醒。讲台上，老王老师放下保温杯，开始分发物理模拟考的试卷。白色的试卷像雪片一样落在课桌上，林宇拿起属于自己的那份，目光扫过密封袋上的考号——0731。他不知道，这个考号，将在几个小时后，出现在国家安全局的最高机密名单上。他更不知道，赵天雷那个看似幼稚的赌约，背后牵扯的是足以改变整个龙国命运的尖端科技。而此刻，他只是一个即将面临高考的普通学生，手里拿着一份看似寻常的模拟试卷，指尖残留着豆浆的温热，和一丝若有似无的、来自未来的电流。早自习的喧嚣渐渐平息，考场里只剩下笔尖划过纸张的沙沙声。林宇深吸一口气，拆开了密封袋。然而，当他看到试卷上的题目时，瞳孔却骤然收缩——那上面，没有一道是他复习过的高考内容。取而代之的，是三组复杂到令人窒息的矩阵方程，以及一张附着在最后一页的cad图纸，图纸右上角用红色印章赫然标注着：“绝密★★★应龙-6型第六代隐形战机核心技术验证稿设计者：陈敬之”林宇的心脏猛地一跳，握笔的手指关节因为用力而发白。他想起了赵天雷鞋底的碎纸，想起了领带夹反射的引擎图，想起了父亲铁盒里那本《航空动力基础》……一切线索，在此刻骤然汇聚。他抬起头，目光穿过密密麻麻的课桌，落在前排赵天雷的背影上。后者似乎察觉到了他的注视，微微侧过头，嘴角勾起一抹得意而残忍的笑容。窗外的阳光不知何时变得有些刺眼，透过玻璃照在林宇的试卷上，将那些诡异的公式和图纸照得发亮。他忽然觉得，这个六月的早晨，远比他想象的更加湿热，也更加……危险。蛰伏的毒蛇，已经张开了它的獠牙。而他，似乎已经无可避免地，踏入了一个精心编织的陷阱。只是他不知道，在这个陷阱的尽头，等待他的不是毁灭，而是一场足以颠覆整个文明的——星辰奇遇。
content_en:
In June in Jiangnan City, the air is like a wet rag that cannot be wrung out, sticking tightly to the skin.The morning self-study bell of Class 7 of Jiangnan No. 3 Middle School was torn apart in the sticky morning light, tearing through the stuffy heat of the classroom.The tip of Lin Yu's nose almost touched the spread "Five-Year College Entrance Examination and Three-Year Simulation", but what he focused on was the half-sheet of A4 paper sandwiched in the exercise book.The complex Lorentz transformation formula was outlined in pencil on the paper, and a crooked note was written next to it: "If extra dimensional parameters are introduced, the time term may have a negative solution - To Professor Wang Hao."This was the draft of an email he secretly wrote to a professor at the Department of Physics at Kyoto University last night. His fingers unconsciously rubbed the cap of a cheap pen under the table, leaving a faint circle of sweat."Hey, what secrets of the universe is the top scholar Lin studying?" A deliberately suppressed but clear enough sneer came from the front row.Zhao Tianlei turned around, his school uniform jacket hung loosely on his shoulders, revealing a T-shirt with a limited edition fashion brand printed on it.He propped his elbows up on Lin Yu's desk and slid down his cuffs, revealing a shiny silver wristwatch - it was the latest military communication watch, with an imperceptible eagle emblem engraved on the inside of the strap.Lin Yu did not raise his head, but moved the paper aside: "What's the matter, Mr. Zhao?" "I can't talk to you if I have nothing to do?" Zhao Tianlei grinned, showing his gold-rimmed back molars, and suddenly tilted his wrist, and with a "pop" sound, the enamel water glass Lin Yu placed on the corner of the table was knocked over, and the brown soy milk splashed all over the table, soaking half of the A4 paper he had sandwiched in the book."Sorry, my hands are slippery." Zhao Tianlei's tone was unapologetic, but with a hint of secret pleasure.He watched Lin Yu stand up suddenly, watched the pool of soy milk quickly faint, soaking Lorenz's formula into a blur, and a hint of unnoticeable excitement flashed through his eyes.Lin Yu clenched his fists, and his nails almost dug into his palms.He knew why Zhao Tianlei targeted him.Since the first year of high school, this playboy, whose father is the logistics minister of the military region and whose mother is the CEO of a listed company, has never given him a good look.At first he thought it was a competition for performance ranking, but when Zhao Tianlei began to deliberately make things difficult for him in front of Su Qingying, Lin Yu understood the subtle jealousy.Su Qingying, the monitor of Class 7, Grade 3, is also recognized as the school beauty.She came in from the back door of the classroom with a stack of homework books in her arms. The hem of her white dress swept across the aisle, bringing with it a faint fragrance of gardenia.Seeing the mess in front of Lin Yu's desk, she was stunned for a moment, then quickly walked over and took out a tissue from her bag: "What's going on?" "It's okay," Lin Yu took the tissue and tried to suppress his anger, "Young Master Zhao accidentally knocked it down." Zhao Tianlei leaned on the back of the chair and tapped Lin Yu's exercise book with his fingers. His eyes wandered back and forth between Su Qingying and Lin Yu, with a predator's scrutiny: "Lin Yu, are you talking to Qingying? Just in time.I have a 'physics question' here, aren't you known as the problem solver?Do you dare to try it?" He took out a manila envelope from the drawer and shook it: "Answer it, I will call you 'Dad Lin Yu' three times in front of the whole school next week.If you can't answer it..." He deliberately prolonged his tone and looked at Su Qingying, "How about inviting Qingying to the newly opened Star Cinema?" Lin Yu frowned.Zhao Tianlei's "question" has never been a good one.Last week, he took a so-called "Olympiad question", which turned out to be an unsolvable paradox, purely because he wanted to make him look embarrassed in front of Su Qingying.Su Qingying put the last homework book on Lin Yu's desk and said softly: "Go to self-study soon, stop making trouble." Her voice was like morning dew, which made Lin Yu's anger disappear a lot."No, Qingying," Zhao Tianlei opened the envelope and pulled out a piece of A4 paper, "Just try to help Lin Yu relax. The college entrance examination is very stressful." He slapped the paper in front of Lin Yu, "Do you think this question is difficult?" Lin Yu looked down subconsciously.A set of complex fluid mechanics formulas were printed on the paper, but the accompanying picture was a twisted cross-section of the wing, with a strange jagged structure at the wing tip.The formula was mixed with several symbols that he had never seen before, like some kind of special variable identifier."This is..." Just when Lin Yu wanted to take a closer look, Zhao Tianlei suddenly poked the paper with the tip of his pen, "Do you see clearly? The vector fluid field equation, plus this airfoil design, is enough for you to think about for a while, right?" At this moment, the surveillance camera on the back wall of the classroom turned slightly, and the red work indicator light flashed.The communication meter on Zhao Tianlei's sleeve suddenly vibrated, and an encrypted message flashed quickly on the screen: "The target has been delivered to the Academic Affairs Office, and it will be implemented as planned." He pressed the screen calmly, and a sneer appeared at the corner of his mouth.Lin Yu didn't notice these details.His attention was attracted by a mark on the paper - in the corner of the wing cross-section, "β-7 alloy stress test" was written in very light pencil.These words made his heart tremble. Beta-7 alloy is a new material that is highly classified by the military. He has only seen a vague mention in the old information left by his father."What? You dare not answer?" Seeing his hesitation, Zhao Tianlei immediately pursued the victory, "Or are you saying that you can't even understand?" Lin Yu took a deep breath and was about to speak when he suddenly felt something hit his feet.He bent down to pick up the exercise book that had been soaked with soy milk just now, and out of the corner of his eye he caught a glimpse of the soles of Zhao Tianlei's sneakers.It was a pair of limited edition AJs, with a small piece of inconspicuous shredded paper stuck to the heel.The edges of the shredded paper were a little charred, as if they had been burnt by fire. There were a few words printed on it in No. 4 Song font: "Top Secret·Sixth Generation Machine..." The words at the back were worn away by the texture of the soles, but the two red seals of "Top Secret" and the three words "Sixth Generation Machine" struck Lin Yu's brain like a bolt of lightning.Sixth generation machine?!The sixth-generation stealth fighter being developed by Longguo is a top-level national secret. Even there are only sporadic speculations on the Internet. Why is there such shredded paper on the soles of Zhao Tianlei's shoes?Lin Yu suddenly raised his head and met Zhao Tianlei's probing gaze.The latter seemed to have noticed something, and subconsciously pulled his feet back, and the smile on his face also faded a bit: "What are you looking at? If you can't answer, just say it, don't dawdle."

Just then, footsteps came from the front door of the classroom.Lao Wang, the invigilator, walked in with a thermos cup. He seemed to have not slept well last night. His eyes were bloodshot and he yawned greatly.The sun shines through the window and shines on the tie clip on his chest - it is an ordinary metal clip, but at this moment it reflects the light onto the A4 paper Zhao Tianlei placed on the table.Something amazing happened.The light spot reflected by the tie clip falls exactly on the inlet position of the wing cross-section, and combined with the lines on the paper, it actually forms a complete three-dimensional engine cross-section!Although it was just a glimpse, Lin Yu clearly saw the complex internal circulation structure in the picture, which was by no means a design that ordinary aircraft engines should have."Ding-a-ling--" The bell that ended the morning self-study suddenly rang, interrupting Lin Yu's thoughts.Zhao Tianlei quickly took back the A4 paper and stuffed it into the envelope: "How about it, Lin Yu? Have you thought about it? Do you dare to bet?" Lin Yu looked at him and subconsciously glanced at the sole of his shoe - the piece of paper had been quietly rubbed off by Zhao Tianlei.But the "Top Secret Sixth Generation Aircraft" and the image of the engine reflected in the tie clip he just saw were like two pebbles thrown into the lake, causing ripples in his heart.He recalled the iron box that his father left before his death. In addition to a few yellowed old photos, there was also a book called "Fundamentals of Aeronautical Power" with a worn cover. On the title page, it was written in pen: "Technology knows no borders, but scientists have a motherland." His father was an engineer in the aviation industry, but later resigned for some reason and died in depression.Is there any connection between Zhao Tianlei's family and his father's past?"Just bet." Lin Yu suddenly spoke, his voice was not loud, but extremely firm.He didn't know what Zhao Tianlei's purpose was, nor what was hidden behind this strange A4 paper, but he could feel that something was quietly changing.Zhao Tianlei was stunned for a moment, as if he didn't expect Lin Yu to agree.He immediately smiled: "Okay! That's enough! Let's wait and see." After saying that, he turned back to his seat, took out his mobile phone from his pocket, and quickly edited a message: "The bait has been hooked, and the test paper will be replaced as planned." Outside the window, a helicopter painted with civilian logos quietly passed over the top of the teaching building, and the roar of the propeller was filtered into a low buzz by the soundproof glass of the classroom.No one noticed that a lead-sealed metal box was slowly lowered from the pod in the belly of the helicopter, aiming directly at the confidentiality room of the school's Academic Affairs Office.Lin Yu looked at Zhao Tianlei's back, then looked down at the traces of soy milk soaked on the table.Those blurred ink marks, for some reason, formed an extremely tiny vortex pattern that resembled an energy cycle.He subconsciously traced the pattern with his fingers, and suddenly felt a weak electric current coming from his fingertips, as if something was quietly awakening in the darkness.On the podium, Teacher Lao Wang put down the thermos cup and began to distribute the physics simulation test papers.The white test paper fell on the desk like snow flakes. Lin Yu picked up his own copy and glanced at the test number - 0731 - on the sealed bag.He didn't know that this examination number would appear on the National Security Agency's top secret list in a few hours.He didn't even know that Zhao Tianlei's seemingly childish bet involved cutting-edge technology that could change the fate of the entire Dragon Kingdom.At this moment, he was just an ordinary student who was about to face the college entrance examination. He was holding a seemingly ordinary mock test paper in his hand. The warmth of soy milk remained on his fingertips, as well as a faint trace of electricity from the future.The hustle and bustle of morning self-study gradually subsided, and the only sound left in the examination room was the rustling of pen tips across paper.Lin Yu took a deep breath and opened the sealed bag.However, when he saw the questions on the test paper, his pupils suddenly shrank - none of them were the content of the college entrance examination that he had reviewed.Instead, there were three sets of suffocatingly complex matrix equations, and a CAD drawing attached to the last page. The upper right corner of the drawing was marked with a red seal: "Top Secret ★★★ Yinglong-6 Sixth Generation Stealth Fighter Core Technology Verification Draft Designer: Chen Jingzhi." Lin Yu's heart skipped a beat, and the knuckles holding the pen turned white from exertion.He thought of the shredded paper on the soles of Zhao Tianlei's shoes, the engine diagram reflected in his tie clip, and his father's "Fundamentals of Aviation Power" in the iron box... All the clues suddenly came together at this moment.He raised his head and looked through the densely packed desks, landing on the back of Zhao Tianlei in the front row.The latter seemed to be aware of his gaze, turning his head slightly, with a smug and cruel smile on his lips.The sunlight outside the window became dazzling at some point, shining through the glass on Lin Yu's test paper, illuminating the weird formulas and drawings.He suddenly felt that this June morning was far more humid, hotter, and more... dangerous than he had imagined.The dormant poisonous snake has opened its fangs.And he seemed to have inevitably stepped into a carefully crafted trap.But he didn't know that what awaited him at the end of this trap was not destruction, but an adventure in the stars that could subvert the entire civilization.
title_en: Recommended popular novels that have been completed
content_zh:
江南市的六月，空气像一块拧不干的湿抹布，紧紧贴在皮肤上。江南三中高三（7）班的早自习铃，就在这样黏腻的晨光里，撕拉着划破了教室的闷热。林宇的鼻尖几乎要碰到摊开的《五年高考三年模拟》，但他视线聚焦的，却是夹在习题册里的半张a4纸。纸上用铅笔勾勒着复杂的洛伦兹变换公式，旁边歪歪扭扭写着批注：“若引入额外维度参数，时间项或可出现负解——致王浩教授”。这是他昨晚偷摸给京都大学物理系教授写的邮件草稿，手指无意识地在桌下摩挲着廉价钢笔的笔帽，留下一圈浅浅的汗渍。“哟，林大状元又在研究什么宇宙奥秘呢？”前排传来刻意压低却足够清晰的嗤笑。赵天雷转过身，校服外套松垮地搭在肩上，露出里面印着限量版潮牌的t恤。他手肘往林宇桌上一撑，袖口滑落，露出一截银光闪闪的腕表——那是最新款的军用通讯表，表带内侧刻着不易察觉的鹰徽标志。林宇没抬头，只是往旁边挪了挪卷子：“赵少有事？”“没事就不能跟你聊聊？”赵天雷咧嘴一笑，露出镶了金边的后槽牙，突然手腕一斜，“啪嗒”一声，林宇放在桌角的搪瓷水杯被撞翻，褐色的豆浆泼了一桌子，正好浸湿了他夹在书里的那半张a4纸。“抱歉啊，手滑。”赵天雷语气里毫无歉意，反而带着一丝隐秘的快意。他看着林宇猛地站起身，看着那摊豆浆迅速晕开，将洛伦兹公式泡得模糊，眼底掠过一丝不易察觉的兴奋。林宇攥紧了拳头，指甲几乎嵌进掌心。他知道赵天雷为什么针对他。从高一开始，这个仗着父亲是军区后勤部长、母亲是上市公司老总的纨绔子弟，就没给过他好脸色。起初他以为是成绩排名的竞争，但当赵天雷开始在苏清影面前刻意刁难他时，林宇才明白那点微妙的嫉妒。苏清影，高三（7）班的班长，也是公认的校花。她抱着一摞作业本从教室后门进来，白色的连衣裙裙摆扫过过道，带起一阵若有似无的栀子花香。看到林宇桌前的狼藉，她愣了一下，随即快步走过来，从包里拿出纸巾：“怎么回事？”“没事，”林宇接过纸巾，尽量压下火气，“赵少不小心碰倒了。”赵天雷靠在椅背上，手指敲着林宇的练习册，眼神在苏清影和林宇之间来回逡巡，带着一种捕猎者的审视：“林宇，跟清影说话呢？正好，我这儿有道‘物理题’，你不是号称解题王吗？敢不敢试试？”他从抽屉里掏出一个牛皮纸信封，晃了晃：“答出来，我下周升旗礼上，当着全校面喊你三声‘林宇爸爸’。答不出来……”他故意拖长了音调，目光落在苏清影身上，“那就请清影去新开的星际影城看首映，怎么样？”林宇皱眉。赵天雷的“题”从来没安好心。上周他就拿了道所谓的“奥赛题”，结果是道无解的悖论，纯粹想让他在苏清影面前出丑。苏清影把最后一本作业本放在林宇桌上，轻声说：“快早自习了，别闹了。”她的声音像清晨的露珠，让林宇心头的火气消了不少。“别啊清影，”赵天雷打开信封，抽出一张a4纸，“就当帮林宇放松一下，高考压力大嘛。”他把纸拍在林宇面前，“你看这题，难不难？”林宇下意识地低头看去。纸上印着一组复杂的流体力学公式，配图却是一个扭曲的机翼截面图，翼尖处有个奇怪的锯齿状结构。公式里夹杂着几个他从未见过的符号，像是某种特殊的变量标识。“这是……”林宇刚想仔细看看，赵天雷突然用笔尖戳向纸张，“看清楚了？矢量流体场方程，加上这个翼型设计，够你琢磨一阵了吧？”就在这时，教室后墙的监控摄像头轻微转动了一下，红色的工作指示灯闪了闪。赵天雷袖口的通讯表突然震动了一下，屏幕上快速闪过一行加密信息：“目标已送达教务处，按计划执行。”他不动声色地按灭屏幕，嘴角勾起一抹冷笑。林宇没注意到这些细节。他的注意力被纸上的一个标注吸引了——在机翼截面图的角落，用极淡的铅笔写着“β-7合金应力测试”。这几个字让他心头一凛，β-7合金是军方高度保密的新型材料，他只在父亲留下的旧资料里见过一次模糊的提及。“怎么？不敢答？”赵天雷见他迟疑，立刻乘胜追击，“还是说，连看都看不懂？”林宇深吸一口气，正要开口，突然感觉脚下碰到了什么东西。他弯腰去捡刚才被豆浆浸湿的练习册，眼角余光瞥见赵天雷的运动鞋鞋底。那是一双限量版的aj，鞋跟处沾着一小块不起眼的碎纸。碎纸边缘有些焦黑，像是被火燎过，上面用四号宋体印着几个字：“绝密·六代机……”后面的字被鞋底的纹路磨掉了，但“绝密”两个红色印章和“六代机”三个字，像一道闪电劈中了林宇的大脑。六代机？！龙国正在研发的第六代隐形战机，属于最高级别的国家机密，连网络上都只有零星的猜测，赵天雷的鞋底怎么会有这种碎纸？林宇猛地抬头，正好对上赵天雷探究的目光。后者似乎察觉到了什么，下意识地把脚往后缩了缩，脸上的笑容也淡了几分：“看什么看？答不出来就直说，别磨磨蹭蹭的。”

就在这时，教室前门传来脚步声。监考老师老王拿着保温杯走进来，他昨晚似乎没睡好，眼睛里布满血丝，打了个大大的哈欠。阳光透过窗户，照在他胸前的领带夹上——那是个造型普通的金属夹，此刻却将光线反射到赵天雷放在桌上的a4纸上。奇妙的事情发生了。领带夹反射的光斑，恰好落在机翼截面图的进气道位置，与纸上的线条组合在一起，竟然形成了一个完整的三维引擎剖面图！虽然只是惊鸿一瞥，但林宇清楚地看到了图中复杂的内循环结构，那绝不是普通飞机引擎该有的设计。“叮铃铃——”早自习结束的铃声突兀地响起，打断了林宇的思绪。赵天雷迅速抽回那张a4纸，塞进信封：“怎么样，林宇？想好了吗？敢不敢赌？”林宇看着他，又下意识地瞟了一眼他的鞋底——那块碎纸已经被赵天雷悄悄蹭掉了。但刚才看到的“绝密·六代机”和领带夹反射的引擎图，像两颗投入湖面的石子，在他心里激起了层层涟漪。他想起父亲临终前留下的那个铁盒，里面除了几张泛黄的旧照片，还有一本封面磨损的《航空动力基础》，扉页上用钢笔写着：“技术无国界，但科学家有祖国。”父亲曾是航空工业的工程师，后来因故离职，郁郁而终。难道赵天雷的家族，和父亲的过去有什么联系？“赌就赌。”林宇突然开口，声音不大，却异常坚定。他不知道赵天雷的目的是什么，也不知道这张奇怪的a4纸背后隐藏着什么，但他能感觉到，有什么东西正在悄然改变。赵天雷愣了一下，似乎没想到林宇会答应。他随即露出笑容：“好！够种！那就等着瞧吧。”说完，他转身坐回座位，从口袋里摸出手机，快速编辑了一条信息：“饵已上钩，按计划替换试卷。”窗外，一架涂装着民用标识的直升机悄然掠过教学楼顶，螺旋桨的轰鸣声被教室的隔音玻璃过滤成低沉的嗡嗡声。没有人注意到，直升机腹部的吊舱里，正缓缓降下一个被铅封的金属箱，目标直指学校教务处的保密室。林宇看着赵天雷的背影，又低头看了看桌上被豆浆浸湿的痕迹。那些晕开的墨迹，不知为何，竟然组成了一个极其微小的、类似能量循环的漩涡图案。他下意识地用手指描摹着那个图案，突然感觉指尖传来一阵微弱的电流感，像是有什么东西，正在黑暗中悄然苏醒。讲台上，老王老师放下保温杯，开始分发物理模拟考的试卷。白色的试卷像雪片一样落在课桌上，林宇拿起属于自己的那份，目光扫过密封袋上的考号——0731。他不知道，这个考号，将在几个小时后，出现在国家安全局的最高机密名单上。他更不知道，赵天雷那个看似幼稚的赌约，背后牵扯的是足以改变整个龙国命运的尖端科技。而此刻，他只是一个即将面临高考的普通学生，手里拿着一份看似寻常的模拟试卷，指尖残留着豆浆的温热，和一丝若有似无的、来自未来的电流。早自习的喧嚣渐渐平息，考场里只剩下笔尖划过纸张的沙沙声。林宇深吸一口气，拆开了密封袋。然而，当他看到试卷上的题目时，瞳孔却骤然收缩——那上面，没有一道是他复习过的高考内容。取而代之的，是三组复杂到令人窒息的矩阵方程，以及一张附着在最后一页的cad图纸，图纸右上角用红色印章赫然标注着：“绝密★★★应龙-6型第六代隐形战机核心技术验证稿设计者：陈敬之”林宇的心脏猛地一跳，握笔的手指关节因为用力而发白。他想起了赵天雷鞋底的碎纸，想起了领带夹反射的引擎图，想起了父亲铁盒里那本《航空动力基础》……一切线索，在此刻骤然汇聚。他抬起头，目光穿过密密麻麻的课桌，落在前排赵天雷的背影上。后者似乎察觉到了他的注视，微微侧过头，嘴角勾起一抹得意而残忍的笑容。窗外的阳光不知何时变得有些刺眼，透过玻璃照在林宇的试卷上，将那些诡异的公式和图纸照得发亮。他忽然觉得，这个六月的早晨，远比他想象的更加湿热，也更加……危险。蛰伏的毒蛇，已经张开了它的獠牙。而他，似乎已经无可避免地，踏入了一个精心编织的陷阱。只是他不知道，在这个陷阱的尽头，等待他的不是毁灭，而是一场足以颠覆整个文明的——星辰奇遇。
